name: Varsen Fieldwork Ripstop Cargo Short
description:
Heavy-duty cargo shorts cut just above the knee, in a mid-weight ripstop that holds its structure through years of hard use. Six pockets: two hip, two cargo, one rear, one hidden interior. Reinforced at the hem, seat, and pocket openings. Available in khaki, slate grey, and dark brown.

Workhorse legwear for the warmer months — common on dockworkers, construction crews, and anyone who spends time on their feet in heat. Functional without pretense. The shorts hold up long after the stitching on cheaper alternatives gives out.
functionality: Six pockets including one hidden interior, reinforced hem and seat, pocket openings rated for frequent heavy use
what_it_says: You work outside, you carry things, and you don't spend money on clothes unless they earn it.
story_hooks: A pair left behind at a job site has a folded note tucked inside the hidden pocket — coordinates and a time, three days from now.
A brand-new pair shows up in a secondhand bin with the tags still on, all pockets empty except one — which contains a keycard to an unfamiliar facility.

physical_description.visual_profile: Utilitarian silhouette with generous cargo pockets on the thighs, cut just above the knee for mobility and air flow. Sits at the natural waist with a straight, unfussy profile. Projects durability and practicality—the uniform of manual labor and field work.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the hip and thigh with a straight leg taper. Designed for layering over protective gear or worn solo. Room for movement without excess fabric.
physical_description.primary_material: Mid-weight ripstop composite—synthetic blend with reinforced fiber weave resistant to tearing and abrasion
physical_description.texture: Tightly woven with visible ripstop pattern; slightly stiff when new, softens with wear. Reinforced stitching visible at stress points—seat, hems, pocket openings.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in utilitarian palette: khaki (worn-sand), slate grey (industrial), and dark brown (weathered earth). Minimal branding; natural fade patterns from sweat and UV exposure.
physical_description.closures: Standard button fly with reinforced bartacks; belt loops integrated into waistband for heavy-duty belt support
distinctive_features: Six functional pockets: dual hip pockets, dual cargo pockets with accordion pleats, rear pocket, hidden interior security pocket
Triple-stitched seams at all stress points
Reinforced hem tape and pocket openings to prevent fraying
Faded creases and worn patches typical from authentic field use
Varsen branding tag at interior waistband only—no visible logos
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4: Working-class essential. Affordable and built to last. Accessible to union dock crews and independent contractors, not corpo issue.
physical_description.cultural_context: The garment of hands-on workers—dockworkers, construction crews, field engineers, maintenance specialists. Signals honest labor and practical experience. Worn by those who can't afford downtime or equipment failure.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and worn. Grass stains, grease marks, faded patches from sun and sweat. Loose threads at pocket edges. Creases that won't wash out. The more weathered, the more trusted.
